pairs.registryProposal: In developer-facing CLI and MCP surfaces that emit Markdown or plaintext tables without CSS design tokens, status glyphs (e.g., Unicode symbols like ✅, ❌, ⚠️, ⏳, •, ·) serve the exact role of status color badges; the standard could explicitly formalize glyph mappings and fallback directions for text-only rendering layers.
